name: varvig
description: Varvig MCP gate — a scoped, propose-only source-control gate for agents. Reads are logged into provenance; the gate can create proposals but never promote a ref.
long_description: The Varvig MCP gate exposes a single task's read set to an agent over stdio: list and read files, search, resolve refs, and read changes and history within a scope, then propose signed, speculative changes. The write path is append-only, so no tool is destructive and there is no promotion tool — promotion is a separate, human-gated step. This bundle embeds the varvig binary for one platform; the version is stamped at release time and pinned by the varvig-tools marketplace.

tools.name: varvig_task_context
tools.description: Report the task's identity, operating mode, scope, and base state.

tools.name: varvig_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a ref or partial hash to a full object hash, within scope.

tools.name: varvig_list_tree
tools.description: List a directory within the task's scope.

tools.name: varvig_read_file
tools.description: Read a file's contents, with optional line ranges, within scope.

tools.name: varvig_find_files
tools.description: Find files by glob within scope.

tools.name: varvig_search_text
tools.description: Search file contents (literal or regex) within scope.

tools.name: varvig_read_change
tools.description: Read a change intent-first: intent, then evidence, then changed paths.

tools.name: varvig_read_log
tools.description: List change history for a ref or path.

tools.name: varvig_read_ticket
tools.description: Read intent records (tickets) and their discussion; list or detail. Read-only.

tools.name: varvig_list_proposals
tools.description: List this task's proposed, un-promoted changes.

tools.name: varvig_propose
tools.description: Propose a signed, speculative change; never promotes a ref.
